description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration particulars. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4.
